paro.title: Paro Valley Package — Himalayan Fly Fishing | Divine Fly Fishing
paro.description: Experience a 10-day technical fly fishing journey in the iconic Paro Valley. Master the art of stalking wild trout in the shadow of ancient dzongs.
paro.heading: The Art of Fishing the Paro Chhu
paro.intro: The Paro Valley offers a blend of accessibility and technical challenge. From the wide, gravel-bottomed stretches in the lower valley to the intimate, high-gradient mountain streams, this 10-day journey is a masterclass in reading Himalayan waters.
infos: Intermediate. Suitable for all with a passion for stalking.
4wt to 6wt rods. Versatile leader setups recommended.
Sight fishing and pocket water management techniques.
Wild Brown Trout, Snow Trout, Native Species.

days.title: Arrival & Valley Orientation
days.text: Arrive at Paro International Airport. Meet your head guide and transfers to your heritage lodge. Afternoon briefing and gear organization overlooking the Paro Chhu.

days.title: Lower Paro Chhu introduction
days.text: A gentle day on the wider lower stretches of the river. Focus on reading the currents and understanding the behavior of local Brown Trout.

days.title: Tiger's Nest Hike & Evening Hatch
days.text: Morning hike to the iconic Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Rest in the afternoon before a technical dry-fly session during the evening hatch near the lodge.

days.title: Upper Paro Chhu (Drukyel Dzong)
days.text: Moving north towards the Drukyel Dzong ruins. The river becomes swifter and more technical with pocket water and deep pools requiring precise casting.

days.title: Technical Stalking in Gunitsawa
days.text: Deep exploration of the Gunitsawa stretches. This is stalking country. Low profile approaches and long leaders are essential to hook the wary resident trout.

days.title: Pachu River Confluence
days.text: Fishing the confluence where the Pachu meets the main river. The mixing of waters creates prime feeding lanes and opportunities for larger fish.

days.title: Shana Village Tributaries
days.text: A trek into the remote Shana village area. Exploring crystal-clear tributaries that offer intimate sight-fishing for wild Snow Trout.

days.title: Intimate Stream Management
days.text: Refining stream-craft in narrow, overgrown stretches. This day focuses on side-casts and roll-casting accuracy in challenging terrain.

days.title: Cultural Tour & Farewell Cast
days.text: Visit to Paro Rinpung Dzong and local markets. Afternoon "choice" session to target your favorite stretch of the week, followed by a riverside dinner.

days.title: Departure
days.text: Final morning reflections and transfer to Paro International Airport for departure.

paro.booktext: Secure your technical fly fishing journey today. Our team will contact you within 24 hours to discuss seasonal availability and gear requirements.

bumthang.title: Bumthang Valley Package — Spiritual Fly Fishing | Divine Fly Fishing
bumthang.description: Experience a 10-day trophy fly fishing journey in the spiritual heart of Bhutan. Target large Brown Trout in the Tang and Chummey valleys.
bumthang.heading: The Art of Fishing the Bumthang Waters
bumthang.intro: Bumthang, comprising four distinct valleys, is the spiritual epicenter of Bhutan. This 10-day journey takes you deep into the Tang and Chummey valleys to target trophy-sized wild Brown Trout in high-gradient mountain streams and spring-fed tributaries.
infos: Intermediate to Advanced. Experience with technical currents is helpful.
5wt to 7wt rods for trophy sized trout. Heavier headers required.
High-stick nymphing and aggressive streamer presentations.

days.title: Domestic Flight to Bumthang & Jakar Introduction
days.text: Arrive in Paro and take a domestic flight to Bumthang's Bathpalathang Airport. Transfer to your lodge in Jakar. Evening briefing and initial gear calibration for the higher altitude.

days.title: Chummey Valley Intro Streams
days.text: A gentle day on the accessible streams of the Chummey Valley. This area is famous for its textile weaving and intimate, well-oxygenated water home to active Brown Trout.

days.title: Tang Valley - The First Expedition
days.text: Venturing into the remote Tang Valley. The river here is more challenging with deep pools tucked beneath rocky ledges and ancient farmhouses.

days.title: Tang Chhu - Trophy Trout Pursuit
days.text: Targeting the larger stretches of the Tang Chhu. This day focuses on aggressive presenting of streamers and heavy nymphs to entice the valley's trophy Brown Trout.

days.title: Cultural Heritage & Evening Cast
days.text: Visit Kurjey Lhakhang and Tamshing Monastery. In the late afternoon, enjoy a technical "hatch session" on a private stretch of the Chummey Chhu.

days.title: Remote Tang Gorge Fishing
days.text: A trek into the deeper gorge stretches of the Tang Valley. High gradient water and deep canyon pools offer high-adrenaline technical fishing.

days.title: Upper Chummey Springs
days.text: Exploring the spring-fed headwaters of the Chummey Valley. The water temperature is extremely stable here, leading to very active and visually stunning wild trout.

days.title: Ura Valley Day Trip
days.text: Drive to the highest of Bumthang's valleys, Ura. Fishing in the thin high-altitude air requires a slow pace and provides a truly "otherworldly" angling environment.

days.title: Trophy Hunting - Final Casts
days.text: One final day to return to the most productive stretches of the Tang Chhu. Evening farewell feast at the lodge with traditional Bumthap hospitality.

days.title: Flight to Paro & Departure
days.text: Morning flight back to Paro for final souvenir shopping and your onward international connection.

bumthang.booktext: Secure your technical fly fishing journey today. Our team will contact you within 24 hours to discuss seasonal availability and gear requirements.

phobjikha.title: Phobjikha Valley Package — Glacial Fly Fishing | Divine Fly Fishing
phobjikha.description: Experience a 10-day technical fly fishing journey in the stunning Phobjikha Valley. Fish the glacial Bey Chhu and explore the high-altitude wetlands.
phobjikha.heading: The Art of Fishing the Bey Chhu
phobjikha.intro: Phobjikha, the glacial "Valley of the Cranes," offers a mystical setting for fly fishing. The Bey Chhu winds through wide, open marshes and technical high-altitude channels, providing a unique challenge for those seeking wild Brown and Snow Trout in a protected sanctuary.
infos: Advanced. Technical wading and stealth are paramount.
3wt to 5wt rods. Fine tippets and small dries are key.
Marshland wading and technical dry-fly drifts.

days.title: Arrival & Scenic Drive to Phobjikha
days.text: Arrival at Paro and immediate transfer to the high-altitude Phobjikha Valley (approx. 4 hours). Evening briefing and initial gear setup at your valley lodge.

days.title: Crane Center & Acclimatization
days.text: Acclimatize to the 3,000m+ altitude. Visit the Black-Necked Crane Center to learn about the valley's unique conservation efforts. Short introductory cast in the afternoon.

days.title: Intro to the Bey Chhu
days.text: Our first full day on the local Bey Chhu river. Focus on wide, slower stretches to understand the feeding patterns of the wild Brown Trout.

days.title: Upper Glacial Stream Exploration
days.text: Heading to the upper reaches where the water is coldest and swiftest. Technical pocket water fishing requiring fast reactions and accurate casting.

days.title: Lower Valley Wetland Meanders
days.text: A day of technical "stalking" in the winding meanders of the lower valley. The water is deep and slow here, requiring stealth and long-range presentations.

days.title: Trek to Gangtey Goempa & Evening Hatch
days.text: Visit the magnificent 17th-century Gangtey Monastery. Spend the evening targeting the incredible hatching events that attract larger trout from the wetland pools.

days.title: Remote Tributary Hike
days.text: Hike to remote tributaries that feed into the valley floor. These intimate streams offer sight-fishing for active Snow Trout in crystal clear pools.

days.title: Sight Fishing Masterclass
days.text: A day dedicated to refining visual detection and presentation skills in the most transparent stretches of the Bey Chhu.

days.title: Full Valley Traverse & Farewell Dinner
days.text: One final day to cover your favorite stretches. Evening farewell dinner featuring local Bhutanese cuisine and reflections on the week's adventure.

days.title: Departure
days.text: Final morning sunrise in the valley before the return drive to Paro and your departure flight.
